class.name: SourcePPVMT
class.brief_description: Allows reading Source Engine VMT material definitions through the bundled SourcePP KeyValues parser.
class.description:
[SourcePPVMT] exposes a first-cut wrapper over Source material scripts, which are KeyValues text files such as [code]VertexLitGeneric[/code] and [code]LightmappedGeneric[/code]. It can open a VMT from disk, memory, or a resolver-backed VPK/PAK entry, expose the root shader name and parsed properties, and build a stub [StandardMaterial3D] approximation using the supplied diffuse and detail textures. Source [code]patch[/code] materials inherit values from their [code]include[/code] material for shader and texture lookups, while [method get_properties] keeps exposing the parsed root block of the opened file. The generated Godot material intentionally stays simple for now: Source-specific values that do not map cleanly to built-in Godot material features, such as Source's detail scale semantics, are preserved as metadata on the returned material for a future importer pass. [codeblock] var vmt := SourcePPVMT.new() if vmt.open("user://materials/props/crate01.vmt") != OK: return
print(vmt.get_shader()) print(vmt.get_base_texture_path()) print(vmt.get_properties()) [/codeblock]

method.name: close
method.description: Releases the currently loaded VMT.

method.name: create_material
method.description: Builds a stub [StandardMaterial3D] from the currently loaded VMT using the provided Godot textures. If [param base_texture] or [param detail_texture] are [code]null[/code], [SourcePPVMT] attempts to resolve and load the referenced VTFs automatically through its current path and [member resolver]. The approximation maps the diffuse texture to albedo and, when available, also applies detail, bump, and self-illum mask textures. Source-specific values that do not map directly to [StandardMaterial3D] are stored as metadata on the returned material using [code]sourcepp_vmt_*[/code] keys.

method.name: get_base_texture_path
method.description: Returns the normalized [code]$basetexture[/code] reference, inherited through Source [code]patch[/code] includes when applicable, or an empty string if the effective VMT does not define one.

method.name: get_resolved_base_texture_path
method.description: Returns the resolved VTF asset path for [code]$basetexture[/code], or an empty string if the reference cannot be matched to a loose file or resolver-backed VPK entry.

method.name: get_detail_blend_factor
method.description: Returns the parsed [code]$detailblendfactor[/code] value, or [code]1.0[/code] if it is not present.

method.name: get_bump_map_path
method.description: Returns the normalized [code]$bumpmap[/code] reference, or an empty string if the VMT does not define one.

method.name: get_resolved_bump_map_path
method.description: Returns the resolved VTF asset path for [code]$bumpmap[/code], or an empty string if the reference cannot be matched to a loose file or resolver-backed VPK entry.

method.name: get_detail_scale
method.description: Returns the parsed [code]$detailscale[/code] value, or [code]1.0[/code] if it is not present.

method.name: get_detail_texture_path
method.description: Returns the normalized [code]$detail[/code] reference, or an empty string if the VMT does not define one.

method.name: get_resolved_detail_texture_path
method.description: Returns the resolved VTF asset path for [code]$detail[/code], or an empty string if the reference cannot be matched to a loose file or resolver-backed VPK entry.

method.name: get_self_illum_mask_path
method.description: Returns the normalized [code]$selfillummask[/code] reference, or an empty string if the VMT does not define one.

method.name: get_resolved_self_illum_mask_path
method.description: Returns the resolved VTF asset path for [code]$selfillummask[/code], or an empty string if the reference cannot be matched to a loose file or resolver-backed VPK entry.

method.name: get_texture_dependencies
method.description: Returns a dictionary of relevant VMT texture keys to their normalized raw asset references. The current set includes keys such as [code]$basetexture[/code], [code]$detail[/code], [code]$bumpmap[/code], [code]$selfillummask[/code], and [code]$envmapmask[/code] when present. Source [code]patch[/code] materials report inherited effective texture references.

method.name: get_resolved_texture_dependencies
method.description: Returns a dictionary of relevant VMT texture keys to resolved VTF asset paths that can be opened from disk or through [member resolver]. Unresolvable references are omitted.

method.name: get_path
method.description: Returns the last path used to open this VMT, or an empty string if it only exists in memory.

method.name: get_properties
method.description: Returns the parsed root material block as a nested [Dictionary]. Leaf values are returned as strings. Nested KeyValues blocks become nested dictionaries, and duplicate keys are preserved as arrays.

method.name: get_shader
method.description: Returns the root VMT shader key, such as [code]VertexLitGeneric[/code] or [code]LightmappedGeneric[/code]. For Source [code]patch[/code] materials, this returns the included material's effective shader when the include can be resolved.

method.name: get_value
method.description: Returns a top-level value from the root material block. If the key is missing, [param default_value] is returned instead.

method.name: has_value
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the root material block contains [param key].

method.name: is_open
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if a VMT is currently loaded.

method.name: open
method.description: Opens a VMT from disk. If [member resolver] is assigned, [param path] can also point at a registered VPK entry.

method.name: open_from_buffer
method.description: Opens a VMT from in-memory text bytes.

members.member: Optional resolver used to load VMT files directly from registered Source game VPKs.
Optional registered game ID used when querying [member resolver]. If empty, the resolver iterates over registered games in registration order for each requested entry.
